purpose: Teach: 一世/一丸/私用/線引き/お披露目/品位/要人/手先

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、業界に、絶対、一世、絶対、を、絶対、風靡したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we were founding this company, your father—he absolutely dominated that entire industry. That's what I'm asking you to remember.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate delivery. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Pauses between the two central thoughts. The voice of someone speaking from decades of memory—not performing, but bearing witness. Slightly gruff with affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、一丸、絶対、と、絶対、なって、絶対、進んでまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, our staff has moved forward as one unified body. That's something I've learned from him with deep gratitude.
lines.style: Formal but not distant. A steady voice reporting what is true. Slight emphasis on 「一丸」—the unity part matters. Respectful but not hollow. The tone of a man confirming inheritance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、私用、絶対、と、絶対、業務、絶対、絶対、混同しなかったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father never mixed his personal matters with the business, not once. That's the standard I'm asking you to uphold.
lines.style: Quieter now, more intimate. The voice of someone passing on a specific lesson. Slight wistfulness under the firmness—as if he can see your father clearly. No lecture, just clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、線引き、絶対、私の手本です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father's way of drawing that line—that's been my model. I've tried to honor it with gratitude.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Speaking slowly, as if tracing the outline of something precious. Humble without self-deprecation. The voice of someone who has spent years living by a principle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、新製品の、絶対、お披露目、絶対、自ら、絶対、行ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father would personally introduce every new product. He did it himself, every time. That's what I'm asking you to understand.
lines.style: Wistful and clear. The memory brings warmth, but the message is firm. Slight lift on 「自ら」—the personal responsibility part. Not sentimental, but full of respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、当社の、絶対、品位、絶対、守り続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's era, we've maintained the dignity of this company. We've kept it intact, and I carry that forward with gratitude.
lines.style: Tender but steady. The voice of a man who has carried something precious for a long time. Gentle emphasis on 「品位」—the dignity—because it matters. Warm and certain at once.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、要人、絶対、お招き、絶対、丁寧だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father was meticulous with important guests. When he invited them, everything was done with the utmost care.
lines.style: Wistful, almost nostalgic. A slight smile in the voice—remembering a specific kindness. Measured pace. The tone of someone recalling a small, perfect detail that says everything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、自らを、絶対、お客様の、絶対、手先、絶対、と、絶対、考えていらしたそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. From what I've heard, your father saw himself as the customer's instrument. He thought of himself as being in their hands. That's something I've learned from him with deep respect.
lines.style: Wise, almost philosophical close. Slow, deliberate delivery. The voice settles into the weight of that idea—customer first, self as tool. Calm and certain. The final word lands like a small bell.
